title: Performance and Efficiency of Climate In Situ Data Reconstruction: Why Optimized IDW Outperforms Kriging and Implicit Neural Representation
why_not_core_crs: The experiments reconstruct sparse ECA&D in-situ meteorological station observations rather than a remote-sensing or Earth-observation product, so the paper fails the repository's direct-sensing Gate A despite using an INR baseline.
why_keep_as_context: It is useful counter-evidence showing that a coordinate-based INR can be less accurate and less efficient than optimized IDW for sparse climate-station reconstruction; it helps delimit where continuous neural representations are not automatically advantageous.
